notes.title: Games in Italy 2023
notes.content:
Welcome to Italy!

This is the third edition of Games in Italy, the special sale dedicated to Italian games on Steam!

Italy is known around the world for food, art, design, fashion, and automobiles. Yet, Italy is also home to so many video games. Works with an international scope, winners of numerous awards and prizes.

It's time to celebrate Italy, and until december 12, "A Painter's Tale" will be available on Steam at 50% off!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1283370/A_Painters_Tale_Curon_1950/

notes.title: A Painter's Tale Giveaway
notes.content:
IT'S GIVEAWAY TIME
Win a copy of our game

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37945390/714a006e433632a1b8f20fb01d6d27d9762fc224.png

It's time to celebrate Spring! 🌸
From March 15th to April 15th you can win one of the three available Steam keys of the game!

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

“A Painter's Tale” is an adventure game that tells the story of the tiny Südtirol village of Curon Venosta by mixing reality and fiction. The old Curon was flooded by the waters of Lake Reschen in 1950 due to the construction of a dam. What lies beneath the bell tower still emerging from the lake?

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

notes.title: A Painter's Tale: Curon, 1950 patch 1.0.8
notes.content:
“You asked. We listened.”
We are excited to release our second patch with some interesting new fixes!


 New automatic save points added!
 Minor bug fixes.

notes.title: A Painter's Tale: Curon, 1950 patch 1.0.5
notes.content:
The team at Monkeys Tales Studio has been very hard at work, and we are excited to release our first patch for "A Painter's Tale" with the last fixes.


 New checkpoint added at the end of prologue.
 Solved some collision problems.
 Solved loading of german language.
 Solved wrong NPCs compenetration.
 Various smaller bug-fixes.
